==Explination of recent edit==
After finishing the glossary for ''[[The Great Hunt/Glossary|The Great Hunt]]'' and looking at the rest of the glossaries for the series, I see that there wasn't much in the way of conformity. As such, I have edited this glossary to reflect "the majority," or what was prevalent through all of them. Entry items don't get italicized unless they are normall so (i.e. ''angreal'', ''Tel'aran'rhiod'', ect.). The pronunciation also isn't italicized. As for the colons at the end of the entry, the only way I could make them appear is if they had formatting around them. If they didn't have the formatting, they didn't show up. As it was more work to show them than not, I choose not to show them. Also, the "See also" and "See" parts of some of the entries were ususally just italicized and did not have the colon after them. So, if the community would like, compare and contrast this glossary with TGH's glossary and see what fits. I'll be starting the glossary for {{Tdr}} next week. ----[[User:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#000099;"> '''Willie'''</span>]] - [[User Talk:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#990099;">'''''HtS'''''</span>]] 17:18, January 5, 2010 (UTC)
